urls.description: List of Apache server URLs (including path and query) to scrape metrics from. Must include ?auto to enable machine-readable output.

items.description: Full URL to an Apache server-status endpoint (with ?auto)

listen_address.description: IP address the exporter should bind to for exposing metrics

port.description: Port number the exporter listens on for Prometheus scraping

status_path.description: Path to Apache's mod_status handler (before the ?auto query)

tls_enabled.description: If true, connect to Apache over HTTPS (do NOT confuse with exporter TLS — exporter itself is always HTTP)

auth_username.description: Basic auth username to access Apache mod_status endpoint (if protected)

auth_password.description: Basic auth password to access Apache mod_status endpoint (if protected)

request_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before aborting a request to Apache (0 disables timeout)

collect_ssl.description: Whether to collect SSL/TLS-related metrics (requires Apache SSL module and proper configuration)

extra_args.description: Additional command-line flags to pass to the exporter (e.g., ['--no-collect-vhost'] to disable vhost metrics)

headers.description: HTTP headers to attach to every request to Apache mod_status (e.g., for proxy auth, custom headers)
